data.description:
Marshall Suites is located in the heart of Bainbridge, 14 km from Seattle. Free WiFi is provided.

All rooms include a TV with cable channels, a microwave, and is fitted with a private bathroom equipped with a bath or shower.

Bellevue is 25 km from Marshall Suites, while Lynnwood is 27 km from the property. Sea-Tac Airport is 27 km away.

Please note the property only accepts dogs weighing a maximum of 36 kg.

The Washington State Ferry will not be in service from September 7, 2023, to September 13, 2023.  If you are planning on using the ferry as transportation to/ from Bainbridge Island during your stay please contact us for other transportation options.
Please note: Parking is for hotel guests only. Please see the polices section for parking rates.

Stay in the heart of Seattle.
Located just 10 minutes' walk away from The Space Needle, The Mediterranean Inn features a rooftop patio with panoramic views of the Seattle Skyline, Mount Rainier, the Olympic Mountains, and Elliot Bay. A fitness centre is located on site.

All guest rooms at this hotel include a flat-screen TV, full sized work desk, a microwave, small refrigerator, coffee maker, and kitchenette. All rooms include en-suite bathrooms that include hairdryers.

A 24-hour reception greets guests of The Mediterranean Inn.  A business centre and 24-hour laundry facilities are provided to guests. Vending machines featuring snacks and drinks are available. Coffee is available in the lobby.

Pike Place Market is 2 km away from this hotel. Hosting sports and entertainment events, KeyArena is 3 minutes’ walk away.

Please note that only service animals are allowed. Guests need to inform about the service animal before arrival.


The property accepts credit cards and debit cards. Cash is not accepted.

When booking more than 10 rooms, different policies and additional supplements may apply.

Stay in the heart of Seattle.
Situated conveniently in the South Lake Union district of Seattle, citizenM Seattle South Lake Union is set 1 km from Space Needle, 1.4 km from Seattle Center and 1.5 km from Pike Place Market. Among the facilities of this property are a restaurant, a 24-hour front desk and a shared lounge, along with free high speed WiFi throughout the property. The property is close to popular attractions like Port of Seattle, KeyArena and International Fountain.

The hotel will provide guests with air-conditioned rooms offering a desk, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a shower.
With the room iPad, or the free citizenM app, all guests can control room lights, black-out blinds, curtains, temperature, as well as TV and radio channels. They can also stream from their own Netflix, Prime or Disney+ accounts (and many others), by connecting their phone, tablet or laptop to the TV via Chromecast (at no extra charge).

At citizenM Seattle South Lake Union all rooms are equipped with bed linen and towels.

The accommodation offers a buffet or vegetarian breakfast.

A business centre and ironing facilities are available at citizenM Seattle South Lake Union.

Popular points of interest near the hotel include Museum of Pop Culture, Washington State Convention Center and Westlake Center. The nearest airport is Boeing Field/King County International Airport, 12 km from citizenM Seattle South Lake Union.

I found one hotel that fits your criteria:

1. Guesthouse Kiten (Hotel ID: 1873686)  
   • Location: Gifu (about 40 km north of Nagoya Castle)  
   • Dates: Nov 15–25, 2024 (10 nights)

– “Relaxed place with great location… staff was very helpful.” (3.6/5)  
– “Unique and tastefully presented stay, great!” (4/5)  
– “Cleanliness and comfort. Washrooms were small.” (3.6/5)  
– “Love the location and the staff is super friendly… comfortable and cozy traditional.” (3.2/5)  
– “Highly recommend… charming! Bed comfortable, location great to visit the castle, staff helpful, bikes available.” (4/5)

gen_convs.content:
Here are the top five trending activities and attractions in Melbourne right now—perfect for a family trip:

1. SkyBus Express Airport Transfer  
   • What it is: Direct shuttle between Melbourne Airport and Southern Cross Station  
   • Why it’s great for families: Spacious, luggage-friendly coaches with onboard Wi-Fi  
   • Price: From US $15.14/person one-way  
   • Highlights: Fast, reliable, year-round service (no free-cancellation option)

2. Great Ocean Road Small-group Tour  
   • What it is: Full-day guided drive along Australia’s iconic coastal highway  
   • Why it’s great for families: Stops at family-friendly lookout points (12 Apostles, Loch Ard Gorge)  
   • Price: From US $96.68/adult; free cancellation up to 24 hrs prior  
   • Rating: 4.8 ★ (313 reviews)

3. Eureka Skydeck 88  
   • What it is: Admission to Melbourne’s highest public vantage point (88th floor)  
   • Why it’s great for families: Thrill-ride “The Edge” glass cube; 360° city & bay views  
   • Price: From US $33.34/person; free cancellation up to 24 hrs prior  
   • Rating: 4.5 ★ (185 reviews)

4. Fox Classic Car Collection Admission Ticket  
   • What it is: Museum of rare and prestigious classic cars  
   • Why it’s great for families: Hands-on displays, photo ops with vintage vehicles  
   • Price: From US $11.19/person; free cancellation up to 24 hrs prior  
   • Rating: 4.8 ★ (171 reviews)

5. Melbourne Museum

Here’s a closer look at the “Stone Forest” (Shilin) experience near Kunming, Yunnan:

1. What & Where  
 • Officially called the Naigu Stone Forest (part of the larger Stone Forest Scenic Area), it’s a karst limestone landscape of towering pillars, spires and “stone forests.”  • A UNESCO World Heritage site (AAAAA-class scenic area), yet far less crowded than the Major/Minor Stone Forest sections.  
 • Located roughly 90 km southeast of Kunming city center.

2. Highlights of a Typical Day Tour  
 • Visit Naigu Stone Forest, trek up to a panoramic vantage point and wander the maze of stone-paved trails.  
 • Stop at Suogeyi (“Sani”) Village—an indigenous Yi community within the same heritage zone.  
 • Enjoy a local Yi-style lunch in a village restaurant.  

3. What’s Included  
 • English-speaking guide  
 • Private, air-conditioned vehicle with hotel pick-up/drop-off in Kunming  
 • Lunch (Yi restaurant)  
 • All ground transport and driver fees  

4. Not Included (pay on site)  
 • Naigu Stone Forest entrance fee (≈ 60 RMB per person)  
 • Gratuities   
 • Tolls (≈ 65 RMB one-way for a 5–7 seat car)   
 • Fuel surcharge (≈ 100–150 RMB per vehicle)  
 • Additional food/drinks beyond lunch  

5. Logistics & Booking  
 • Duration: ~ 8–10 hours (depart Kunming early AM, return late afternoon)  
 • Group size: Min. 2, max. 9 people   
 • Price (approx.): USD 105.55 per person   
 • Free cancellation up to 24 hours before tour date   
 • Wheelchair accessible; suitable for all fitness levels  

6. Tips for Your Visit  
 • Wear stout walking shoes—trails are uneven.  
 • Bring sun protection (hat, sunscreen) and bottled water.  
 • If you want fewer crowds, ask your guide to take you to less-visited pockets of the limestone forest.

Here’s a detailed overview of the Forbidden City experience in Beijing based on the latest tour-and-ticket information:

1. General Description  
   • A UNESCO World Heritage site, the Forbidden City served as China’s imperial palace from the Ming dynasty through the end of the Qing dynasty.  
   • You’ll explore vast courtyards, ornate halls and gates at your own pace—either in the morning or afternoon slot you choose.  
   • Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long on-site ticket queues and the need to carry Chinese cash.

2. What’s Included  
   – Official entrance ticket to the Forbidden City  
   – Passport-based entry (your name, overseas passport front page and WhatsApp number are required at booking)  

3. What’s Not Included  
   – Tour guide service or audio guide  
   – Transportation to/from the site  
   – Tickets to Clock Museum, Jewelry Museum or Meridian Gate  
   – Any other expenses not explicitly listed  
   – NOTE: Chinese IDs and domestic passports are not accepted for this pre-book ticket  

4. Price & Booking  
   – Representative price: USD 9.90 per person  
   – Free cancellation is available  
   – Booking is open to anyone 18 years or older (or accompanied by an adult)  
   – You’ll receive an e-ticket and simply present your passport at entry  

5. Accessibility & Health Advisories  
   – Not wheelchair accessible; heavy walking and many stairs  
   – Public transit (e.g. subway) is available nearby  
   – Travelers with spinal injuries, poor cardiovascular health or who are pregnant are advised not to visit  
   – Requires a good level of physical fitness  

6. Operator & Policies  
   – Operated by Authentic China Tours  
   – Standard booking and cancellation terms apply (confirm at time of booking)  

7. Guest Feedback  
   • Average rating: 4.9 / 5 from over 40 reviews  
   • “Great site but a bit tricky to follow the audio-guide route.”  
   • “Plenty of pre-visit info and subway tips—still gets crowded in spots.”  

Whether you’re drawn by its history, architecture or sheer scale, pre-booking a ticket helps you breeze past the long lines and lets you absorb this iconic palace at your own pace. Enjoy your visit!

gen_convs.content:
Here’s a deeper look at the Taj Mahal, one of the world’s most celebrated monuments:

1. Overview & History  
   • Location: Agra, Uttar Pradesh, India, on the south bank of the Yamuna River  
   • Patron: Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan, built in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal  
   • Construction: Began in 1632 and completed around 1653, employing thousands of artisans  
   • UNESCO World Heritage Site: Inscribed in 1983 for “the jewel of Muslim art in India”  

2. Architectural Highlights  
   • Material: Pure white Makrana marble inlaid with semi-precious stones (pietra dura)  
   • Main dome: Rises to about 73 m (240 ft) with four smaller domed kiosks (chattris) at the corners  
   • Symmetry: Perfectly mirrored on an east–west axis; reflecting pools accentuate this balance  
   • Supporting structures:  
     – Red-sandstone gateway (Darwaza) to the south  
     – Mosque on the west side and a jawab (guesthouse) on the east  
     – Formal Charbagh (four-quartered) gardens with water channels  

3. Visiting Information  
   • Hours: Open daily from sunrise to sunset (closed Fridays for prayers)  
   • Best times: Early morning and late afternoon for cooler temperatures and softer light  
   • Entry fees (subject to change):  
     – Foreign visitors ≈ ₹1,100 (includes access to main mausoleum)  
     – Indian visitors ≈ ₹50  
   • Facilities: Shoe-cover counters, clean restrooms, drinking-water points, souvenir stalls  
   • Tips:  
     – Dress modestly and carry minimal metal objects (security checks are strict)  
     – Hire an audio guide or private guide for historical context  
     – Beware of touts; book tickets online or at the official counter  

4. How to Get There  
   • By train: Frequent services from New Delhi (approx. 2–3 hrs) to Agra Cantt or Agra Fort station  
   • By car/coach: 210 km via the Yamuna Expressway (2–4 hrs, depending on traffic)  
   • Local transport: Auto-rickshaws, cycle-rickshaws or hotel-booked cabs for last-mile transfers  

5. Recommended Guided Tour (Optional)  
   If you’d like to turn your visit into a full-day trip from Delhi, there’s a private “Glimpses of Taj Mahal” excursion that includes:  
   • Air-conditioned pickup from Delhi, Gurgaon or Noida  
   • Private live guide at the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort  
   • Complimentary water bottles and umbrellas  
   • Free cancellation up to a certain time  
   • Starting price: USD 9.71 per person  

Whether you’re drawn by its romantic backstory, its engineering marvels or simply the breathtaking play of light on white marble, the Taj Mahal never fails to leave a lasting impression. Let me know if you’d like more on ticketing, nearby hotels or any other tips!

data.description:
Princess Sissi in Vienna and the Imperial Palace

The Hofburg - for centuries the political center of the Habsburg monarchy - museum included!

On the trail of the wonderful Princess Sissi and the history of the Hofburg. On this tour we learn more about Sissi's personality, her work and her influence on history. But not only...

The Hofburg in Vienna was the political center of the Habsburg monarchy for centuries and served as the imperial residence. It reflects the power and splendor of the Habsburg Empire. The Imperial Apartments, part of the Hofburg, offer an insight into the private and public life of the imperial family. Richly furnished with furniture, works of art and personal objects, they convey the splendor and lifestyle of the Habsburgs during their reign.

A peculiarity of the time, for example, was the Sissi gym. We also see the rooms where the emperor held his audiences.

data.description:
Munich is the world capital of beer, which Bavarians consider to be a food (in fact they call it liquid bread). Discover with us the history of this indispensable product of Munich gastronomy and how it traveled from homes to monasteries, from breweries to Biergartens.

In an exclusive tasting, you will enjoy and learn to distinguish the most representative types of beer in the city: Weiss, Helles, Dunkles and Pilsen. In addition, you will try the typical Bavarian bread, the Bretzel.

You will also learn what The Law of Purity (Reinheistgebot) consists of, how yeast was introduced after its discovery in the 19th century, how Oktoberfest and the Spring Festival were born, or what the six great Bavarian brands are...

And, finally, we will reveal the secrets of the most famous brewery in the world: Hofbräuhaus.

An essential tour for beer lovers and to discover a fundamental part of the culture and history of Bavaria.

data.description:
This small-group tour will take you from Athens to the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Meteora to discover its ancient history. You'll embark on a bus drive of just under four hours, taking in the beautiful countryside along the way.

On arrival, you'll visit two of the monasteries built atop the rock pillars and gain insight into Greek Christian monks. You'll also see the other four monasteries from the outside and learn about the history of Eastern Orthodox monastic life.

Before making the return trip, you'll stop in the town of Kalabaka, where you'll have lunch, as well as free time to shop and explore.

data.description:
Embark on this full-day Rio de Janeiro City Tour with a guide and visit Rio de Janeiro's top landmarks and highlights.
We visit to Corcovado Mountain and the Christ the Redeemer statue going through the Paineiras route. The 20-minute drive to the base of the statue takes you through the Tijuca Forest and gives you a preview of the landscapes ahead. The statue stands 710 meters tall and from this vantage point, you’ll have sweeping views of the city.
We also visit the Sugar Loaf. The cable car ride to the top of the mountain is done in 2 stages: begin at the boarding station to Urca Mountain (224 meters) and then from Urca Mountain to the top of Sugarloaf Mountain (395 meters).
Let’s also stop at the Metropolitan Cathedral, the Arcos da Lapa with the traditional Selarón Staircase, the Sambadrome and the Maracanã Stadium.
This tour includes tour guide, tickets to the Christ the Redeemer and the Sugarloaf, Buffet lunch and round-trip transportation.
